claims: 눈 표면 아래에서 발목 높이의 직교 투영 영역을 바라보며 눈에 닿는 물체를 흰색으로 그린다. 이를 필터링하고 높이맵에 누적해 발·손·몸이 만드는 자국을 기록한다. 콘솔판은 릴리프 매핑으로 깊이를 표현하고 PC DX11판은 테셀레이션으로 실제 표면도 변형한다.
limits: 콘솔판의 가상 깊이 표현과 PC DX11판의 실제 기하 변형을 구분한다. 모든 버전의 눈이 평면이라는 설명은 틀리다.
레드 데드 리뎀션 2 등 다른 게임도 같은 구현이라는 주장은 하지 않는다.
원 발표의 성능 수치를 우리 구현의 측정값으로 표시하지 않는다.
Opening is an intended shot, not a claim that the existing subtle GCPD rooftop sample passed mobile visual-fit QA.
Unity capture, accumulation and rendering are explanatory reconstruction; production shader code, resolution and timings are not measured.
Do not present ordinary mesh subdivision as verified DirectX11 tessellation or infer all console snow is displaced geometry.

oneVariableComparison.variable: Accumulation of the contact capture into the height map
oneVariableComparison.observedResultToDemonstrate: Accumulation preserves the trail behind the foot; without accumulation the earlier contact marks are not retained.

scenePlan.purpose: Intended genuine gameplay footprint/deformation phenomenon. Existing GCPD roof sample is not unmistakable; source gate remains false.
Unity side view reveals bottom-up orthographic camera and ankle-height capture slab, then camera output. No perspective shrink.
Show actual captured white foot/body silhouette on black, small filter, then progressive accumulation into a retained texture.
Identical path/model/camera. Toggle only accumulation: old marks disappear versus trail persists. Explain height-map role with image visible.

Same scene differentiates virtual depth / relief mapping from actual surface displacement. Labels must distinguish console and PC DX11; never label simple Unity mesh displacement measured commercial tessellation.

Return to verified real snow deformation only once a stronger clip is acquired; otherwise draft remains blocked. Hand/body capability supported by developer source, not assumed from current gameplay sample.
